text.markup:
**Prism Specialization** _(You may only have Herald of Judgment in your deck if your hero is Prism.)_
If Herald of Judgment hits, put it into your hero's soul and the defending hero can't play cards from their banished zone during their next action phase. _(Put this card face up under your hero card.)_
**Phantasm** _(If Herald of Judgment is defended by a non-Illusionist attack action card with 6 or more {p}, destroy Herald of Judgment and close the combat chain.)_
